main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (Saturday return - coin mean daily return) over Friday cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one date summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with date-clustered t >= 2 and positive forecast coefficient; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 distinct Fridays with cases

supporting_check.name: forecast coefficient in OLS of Saturday excess return on forecast and Friday return

decided_by: The main measure is positive with t >= 2 and the forecast's regression coefficient is positive.
reading: Friday is the bar whose UTC start timestamp is a Friday and the Monday-to-Thursday side is taken from close[t-1]/close[t-4]-1 (falling back on the sign of the raw mon_thu value when those bars are missing); the date-summed t is the cluster-robust t of the mean (deviations summed per date, G/(G-1) correction); the regression uses OLS with an intercept on cases with Friday's return available; and the plan's minimum of 100 distinct Fridays is applied as 'not observable' when unmet.
